recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: data centers guarding their water and wattage secrets
developers pushing back on yet another protocol layer
one observer's september sketch of the world
clear autumn night at thirteen degrees on the pacific edge
sunrise at seven, sunset near seven — equinox light thinning

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Route coolant through a humming server rack before heat blooms — swipe lanes to steer cold air past hidden power draws.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right to swap coolant channels
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one clean cooling cycle before the rack redlines feels like a surgical save.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: more servers spin up mid-round, heat spreads diagonally across lanes
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green terminal readouts on matte black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick agent orbs from your phone onto queued tasks before the morning build window closes — inspired by spinning up agents from a pocket.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clearing a five-task queue in one satisfying flurry before sunrise.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: tasks fork and multiply, orbs gain sticky drag mid-flight
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor notification bubbles on soft cream

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw wind currents to shepherd a single autumn leaf through gaps in a clear night skyline before it lands.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch a wind trail
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: guiding one leaf rooftop-to-ground in a single breath-long arc.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: gusts shift the path mid-fall, gaps between buildings narrow
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout silhouettes against indigo sky

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: A foggy horizon flashes five future glimpses — tap them back in order before the september mist erases the vision.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: nailing a five-beat prophecy before fog rolls back in.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: visions overlap and decoy tiles flicker in from the edges
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe horizon line dissolving into mist
